results.question: How many films are rated PG and are longer than 120 minutes?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pg_long_films FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG' AND length > 120 LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the total payment revenue from customers whose home store is store 2?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment AS p JOIN customer AS c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.store_id = 2 LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many distinct films were rented in December 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS distinct_films FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_date >= '2025-12-01' AND r.rental_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

results.question: For each film category, how many distinct actors have appeared in its films? Show the category name and the number of actors.
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film_category AS fc JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fc.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the median payment amount?
results.sql: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_payment FROM payment LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which customers made more than 70 rentals? Show first name, last name and the number of rentals.
results.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals FROM rental AS r JOIN customer AS c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) > 70 LIMIT 1000

results.question: For each film category, which film earned the most payment revenue? Show the category name, the film title and its revenue.
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.name) c.name AS category, f.title, rev.revenue FROM (SELECT fc.category_id, f.film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY fc.category_id, f.film_id) AS rev JOIN film AS f ON rev.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category AS c ON rev.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY c.name, rev.revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: What percentage of all customers have rented at least one Horror film?
results.sql: SELECT 100.0 * CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS DECIMAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) AS percentage FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which day of the week has the most rentals? Show the day name and the number of rentals.
results.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(rental_date, 'Day') AS day_name, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental GROUP BY day_name ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many actors have never appeared in a film rated G?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actors_without_G FROM actor AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM film_actor AS fa JOIN film AS f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE fa.actor_id = a.actor_id AND f.rating = 'G') LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many big-spending customers do we have?
How many customers have stopped renting from us?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id) LIMIT 1000

results.question: What proportion of our film catalogue was rented at least once in 2024?
results.sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.rental_date >= '2024-01-01' AND r.rental_date < '2025-01-01') AS DECIMAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS proportion LIMIT 1000

results.question: What share of returned rentals came back late?
results.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date - r.rental_date > MAKE_INTERVAL(days => f.rental_duration) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS late_share FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which actor is our best performer?
results.sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_actor AS fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor AS a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was our AOV in 2024?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_order_value FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND payment_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000
